name: @betterspec/opencode
reasonZh: 包的 package.json 仅把 @opencode-ai/plugin 列为 devDependency，而 dist/index.js 顶层导入 @opencode-ai/plugin/tool，正好对应验证日志中的 Cannot find package 加载失败，且 setup.js 的 child_process 导入不影响该根因。
reasonEn: package.json lists @opencode-ai/plugin only as a devDependency while dist/index.js imports @opencode-ai/plugin/tool, matching the reported unresolved-package load failure and unrelated to the flagged setup.js child_process import.

name: @br4zz4/opencode-smart-tools
reasonZh: 代码证实 setup() 中无保护地调用 context.keymap.layer()，与验证日志中的 TypeError 完全吻合，插件确实无法加载；但包内仅此一个 1.06kB 文件，上下文访问均为良性的插件 API 调用，无恶意行为。
reasonEn: Confirmed: setup() unconditionally calls context.keymap.layer(), matching the logged TypeError and load failure; the entire package is a single 1.06 kB file whose context usages are benign plugin API calls with no malicious behavior.

name: @chalk_calliope/opencode-model-sync
reasonZh: 代码证实唯一网络调用是文档声明的按已配置 provider baseURL 派生 /v1/models，regex.exec 只是 RegExp 匹配而非子进程，模型合并也确实只追加未见过的 ID。
reasonEn: The only network call is the documented GET to each configured provider's derived /v1/models endpoint, regex.exec is ordinary RegExp matching rather than child-process execution, and merging only appends unseen model IDs.

name: @ctliz/pi-intercom
reasonZh: index.ts 的默认导出是接收 ExtensionAPI 的函数而非含 id/effect/setup 的对象，且 package.json 将其作为插件入口，故与 OpenCode 默认导出 schema 不匹配。
reasonEn: index.ts default-exports a function taking ExtensionAPI rather than an object with id/effect/setup, and package.json points the plugin entry there, matching the SchemaError at default.
